svg.text: Analytics on Tableau: many extracts, logic trapped in workbooks, refresh windows and governance gaps
1 Authors build workbooks 2 One .hyper extract per workbook 3 Scheduled refresh from sources 4 Publish to Tableau Server

Pain points (amber): each workbook carries its own .hyper extract, so data is duplicated and can go stale; business logic (calcs, LODs) is copied into every workbook instead of shared; scheduled extract refreshes create latency windows; lineage and certification are hard to see; there is no Git or CI/CD for the workbooks.
